_doc: Dimwit production-engine manifest. status: BUILT (runnable, import+self-validated) | VERIFY (built, needs one live UE/Blender run) | PLANNED. Every pipeline subclasses dimwit.pipelines.base.ProductionPipeline and inherits the fully-proofed recursive loop (plan->execute->QA->repair->hash-chained ledger->gate). Active-slice promotion is ALWAYS operator-gated. Orchestrated by dimwit.director (scripts/pipeline/run_director.py). Self-check: python scripts/pipeline/run_director.py --validate.

director.purpose: Autonomous sweep: order tasks by (priority+EV-cost-fail_penalty), run each pipeline to PROMOTED_TO_REVIEW, per-pipeline circuit breaker, hash-chained director ledger, operator review queue.

character_fidelity.purpose: Full-detail Nanite import (no decimation) + Nanite material flag + satin de-chrome. Closes in-game!=Hi3D-creation.
character_fidelity.proven: Active roster source-to-Unreal fidelity records stay gated by source GLB, imported asset, material, and optics evidence.

rigging.purpose: Auto-rig static Hi3D mesh -> UE5 Mannequin skeletal (Blender automatic weights) so it reuses ABP_Manny.
rigging.proof: weight_coverage~1.0, <=4 influences, bones>=50, UE skeletal imported

animation.purpose: Make a rigged char animate by reusing ABP_Manny / AnimStarterPack (same SK_Mannequin skeleton).

environment.purpose: Procedural WANE-LINE arena from the modular MapKit (deterministic collapse axis), seeded + reproducible.
environment.proof: level_saved + actor_count + PlayerStarts + lighting + wane-line spine/core + no missing kit pieces

vfx.purpose: Niagara WANE VFX per verb (crystallize/erode/snap/hit/death) by duplicating+parameterizing a template system.

audio.purpose: Weaponized-Banter TTS (Piper/pyttsx3/SAPI) -> WAV -> UE SoundWaves + MetaSound source scaffold.
audio.proof: >=1 WAV synthesized + imported as SoundWave + loudness sanity

materials_shaders.purpose: MF_Wane master material function + M_WaneSurface (teal/blue seam mask, saturation, de-chrome) across assets.

marble_ingest.purpose: Bring a Marble (World Labs) AI-generated world into WANEFALL as a playable UE5.8 env: intake/route (collider|hq GLB | splat PLY/SPZ) -> Blender OpenCV->Z-up axis fix + scale calibration + weld/decimate/triangulate -> UE Interchange import as Nanite StaticMesh + UseComplexAsSimple collision + neutral test map.
marble_ingest.proof: V1..V11 fail-closed: axis Z-up + scale calibrated + tri budget + Nanite(vs SOURCE tris) + UseComplexAsSimple + test map saved w/ PlayerStart; provenance fail-closed on commercial license; V11 optics pending live PIE capture
marble_ingest.human_only_boundary: Account creation, commercial-tier subscription, world generation, and export DOWNLOAD are operator-only (marble.worldlabs.ai). Automation begins once an export file exists on disk. SPLAT visual track BLOCKED on 5.8 (no confirmed Gaussian-splat plugin build). See docs/DIMWIT_MARBLE_INGEST.md.

real_game_validation.purpose: Validate the real running WANEFALL game window instead of static files, constructor state, or proxy captures.
real_game_validation.proof: Fresh desktop capture, nonblank still, nonblank frame burst, strict UE log fatal/error scan, and placeholder/blockout geometry signal. Current live state is PASS and promoted to the autonomous review ceiling.

packaged_build_validation.purpose: Validate a release-style packaged Win64 Development build rather than relying only on editor/game-target compile or editor standalone runtime.
packaged_build_validation.proof: Writes artifacts/packaged_build_validation/packaged_build_result.json and package_manifest.json with UAT logs, archive path, executable hash/size, package totals, packaged window capture, frame burst, and packaged log scan.

performance_baseline.purpose: Machine-play the CURRENT packaged build (command deck -> ENTER deploy -> Arena4v4 bot TDM) while the flag-gated in-game perf subsystem samples wall frametime + memory; fail-closed floor gates (p95 16.6ms @1080p, steady hitch count 0, 8GB peak) make packaged performance a per-run truth.
performance_baseline.proof: Writes artifacts/performance_baseline/performance_baseline_result.json with the identity-bound perf payload (per-map menu/arena segments, steady windows, downsampled steady trace), package sha binding, measurement conditions, and recomputed floor checks.

bot_balance_telemetry.purpose: Headless packaged bot-vs-bot Arena4v4 matches at scale through the REAL game loop; emits per-match TTK, fire uptime, weapon usage, 16x16 position heatmaps, and wane-line progression curves so design changes cite receipts (masterplan B2/A2).
bot_balance_telemetry.proof: Writes artifacts/bot_balance/bot_balance_result.json with the flag/pid/exe-sha-bound telemetry payload; gates are recomputed from the per-match array (fabricated aggregates REJECTED) plus drift gates vs the pinned committed baseline (missing baseline BLOCKS).

ui_settings_persistence.purpose: Prove settings persistence on the packaged build: a flag-gated two-launch proof changes all 12 FWanefallSettings + a resolution, persists the profile JSON + applies UGameUserSettings, then a real relaunch reloads from disk and reports what survived (masterplan B4/B6).
ui_settings_persistence.proof: Writes artifacts/ui_settings/ui_settings_result.json with write/verify proofs; gates recompute the 12-field round-trip across relaunch, GameUserSettings apply+persist, non-default coverage, and pid/exe-sha binding (two distinct pids).

self_metrics_director.purpose: The recursive loop measures + schedules itself (A2): self-metrics over the validator suite (domain health, probe mix), an evidence-freshness RADAR that predicts which heavy lanes decay next, and an evidence-ranked operational queue (fix broken domain / re-run stale lane) with receipts.
self_metrics_director.proof: Writes artifacts/self_metrics/self_metrics.json; gates recompute suite/domains/probe_mix from the cited report (fabricated self-grade caught), verify the freshness radar covers every aged lane, and the operational queue is deterministic + evidence-cited (broken->stale->warn).

flagship_arena_art_pass.driver: scripts/ue/ue_arena_flagship_dress.py (saves dressed map) + scripts/ue/ue_arena_capture_tour.py (SceneCapture station tour)
flagship_arena_art_pass.purpose: Dress Wanefall_Arena4v4_Prototype_01 from greybox to a readable wane-themed flagship (kit landmarks + wane/trim materials + lighting rig + wane-energy identity, SAVED into the map) and prove it with a per-station capture tour (masterplan B3).
flagship_arena_art_pass.proof: Writes artifacts/flagship_arena/flagship_arena_dress_result.json + flagship_arena_tour_result.json + per-station stills; gates check kit-landmark dressing over greybox, SkyAtmosphere lighting rig, emissive wane-energy identity, PlayerStarts, and a non-blank distinct-coverage capture tour.

unreal_game_builder_engine.driver: artifacts/validation + autonomy matrix + pipeline contracts + real-game validation + MetaHuman utilization audit
unreal_game_builder_engine.purpose: All-in-one Unreal game-building engine proof layer: maps every major game-production lane to evidence, current blockers, validation commands, rollback paths, and a ranked recursive repair queue.
unreal_game_builder_engine.proof: Writes doctrine, scorecard, and final report artifacts under artifacts/unreal_game_builder; passes only if required lanes are covered, current blockers stay visible, queue actions are ranked, and every action preserves PROMOTED_TO_REVIEW.

metahuman_output_attempt.purpose: Executable fail-closed MetaHuman output lane: attempts a WANEFALL source-mesh-linked MetaHuman character transform and records exact output or blocker evidence.
metahuman_output_attempt.proof: Writes artifacts/metahuman_output_attempt/<character>/metahuman_output_attempt_result.json. Only source-linked transform operations with existing outputs can satisfy MetaHuman output evidence; raw MH_*.uasset or .dna names alone are ignored.

character_roster_policy.driver: config/character_roster.json + imported humanoid/mech evidence + director queue audit
character_roster_policy.purpose: Active roster/quarantine gate: supports 7 active humanoids plus 8 active mech characters while retaining retired prototypes as audit evidence, not active repair blockers.
character_roster_policy.proof: Writes artifacts/character_roster_policy/character_roster_policy_report.json and fails if quarantined characters re-enter director tasks or mech evidence is missing.

character_source_sync.purpose: Fail-closed source chain for active website-generated WANEFALL humanoids: Hi3D GLB, Blender source/retopo/rig anatomy evidence, validated Unreal import, and source-linked MetaHuman output must stay connected. Quarantined characters report retired status instead of consuming repair loops.
character_source_sync.proof: Writes artifacts/character_source_sync/character_source_sync_report.json with per-character stage states, next-action commands, and hard failure for fragmented geometry or dirty rig transforms.

progression.driver: packaged WanefallGreybox.exe -WANEFALLBOTMATCH x2 (two sequential relaunches) + UWanefallProgressionSubsystem
progression.purpose: Proves progression is EARNED from a real bot-match seat and PERSISTS across a real process relaunch: XP/level/challenges recomputed from the emitted apply-proofs, anti-farm cap enforced, and run #2 loads run #1's saved profile (PROGRESSION_PERSISTENCE_V1, masterplan B6).
progression.proof: Writes artifacts/progression/progression_result.json (exe-sha-bound, two distinct pids); gates recompute earned xp/level/challenges from per-match apply-proofs, chain-check accumulation, and assert account_xp after relaunch == run1 + run2 granted (reset REJECTED).
